sections.title: How fusions work
sections.html:
• Two infusions make a fusion. A skill with one infusion becomes that element's version of the skill (Fire's Strike). A skill with two infusions becomes the version of the pair's fusion element: Fire + Fire is Dragon, Fire + Ice is Apocalypse. Order doesn't matter, so Ice + Fire is Apocalypse too. The ten elements make 55 fusions: ten pure ones (one element twice) and 45 pairs.
  • Every fusion has all 30 skills. Each fusion has its own version of every base skill, from Strike to Titan, with its own name, cost, cooldown and effect.
  • Each fusion has its own keywords. New statuses and rules that its skills use, listed at the top of its page and in the keyword glossary. Some fusions also have a passive: any character carrying at least one of that fusion's skills has it for the whole battle.
  • Reading costs. Colored squares are Strength (red), Agility (green), Intelligence (blue) and Wisdom (white) energy; a dashed square is energy of any color; Free means no cost. CD is the skill's cooldown.

I: 5 Piercing damage; against Prey, the user gains 1 random energy. II: 15 Piercing against targets at or below 40 HP. III: it executes Prey below 15 HP.
Tears up to 2 Toxin out of target enemy, then deals them 20 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable, plus 10 per Toxin torn out.
For 1 turn. I: if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain 1 Toxin. II: 1 Toxin per energy it cost. III: it's visible, and any enemy's Harmful skill triggers it. Invisible.
Target enemy gains 2 Toxin, and the venom sets in slowly: at the end of their next turn, if they still have any Toxin, they're Stunned for 1 turn.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness at the start of each of their turns. Each enemy skill that damages them meanwhile deals 5 less to them for the rest of the match (max 15 per skill).
I: target ally heals 20. II: they lose their Toxin and heal 10 more per stack removed. III: the same healing repeats at the start of their next turn.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and Toxin on them heals them for its damage instead of harming them.
Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Debuff stack on them counts as 2 toward Prey.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and marks them for 2 turns. The mark grows each time the user or an ally damages them; when it ends, they gain 1 Toxin per growth (at least 1, at most 4).
All enemies gain 1 Toxin. For 2 turns, each time an enemy's Toxin ticks, a random ally heals 10.
The tail lashes 4 times, each lash dealing 10 damage to a random enemy. Each enemy lashed more than once also gains 1 Toxin.
The user gains 1 Toxin, then all enemies are Intimidated for 1 turn per Toxin the user has (at most 3).
The user gains 10 Shield for 3 turns. The shell hardens as it holds: at the start of each of their turns, it gains 10 Shield.
Target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 2 turns. If they don't damage the user during it, they fall Asleep when it ends.
The user is Stunned and Invulnerable for 1 turn, cocooned. Then, for 3 turns, they gain 3 Armor, 2 Might and Immune.

kits.name: Life
kits.tagline: Earth that grows: a garden that becomes a grove, and a team that keeps getting bigger.
kits.taglineHtml: Earth that grows: a garden that becomes a grove, and a team that keeps getting bigger.
kits.playsLike: A garden, and a team that keeps getting bigger

keywords.text: Healing that would take a unit above max HP raises their max HP by the excess instead, up to +30 per unit for the match.

A Seedling a Life character created that is alive at the end of its creator's second turn after appearing becomes a Treant: 40 max HP, healed to full, with Treant Slam. Treants still count as Seedlings.

passives.name: Grove Tender
passives.text: Seedlings this character creates Bloom into Treants if they survive until the end of its second turn.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, plus 5 per 10 max HP the user has gained from Flourish.
Deals 30 damage to target enemy. Every other unit in the battle, on both sides and minions included, heals 15, which can Flourish.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, and the user creates a Seedling that takes the next hit aimed at the user.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. A Seedling sprouts in its path, and its user is Taunted by the Seedling for 1 turn. Invisible.
The user creates a Seedling. For 3 turns, another sprouts for them at the start of each of their turns, and they deal 5 more direct damage for each allied Seedling (up to 20 more).

Deals 5 damage to target enemy and plants a seed in them for 3 turns. It ripens at the end of each of the user's turns: to 10, then to 25. Using this on them again harvests it first: it bursts for that much damage, and the user heals half of what it dealt, which can Flourish. The user tends one seed at a time: planting one withers their seed in any other enemy, with no burst.
At the end of each of the user's turns while it channels, Channel Growth. In 2 turns, deals 50 damage to target enemy. Channeled.
For 2 turns, each skill target enemy uses tightens the roots: 1 Weakness for 2 turns (max 3). At 3, a Seedling sprouts for the user. Invisible.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and creates a Boulder. If the Boulder still stands at the start of their next turn, it cracks open into a Worldsprout.
Summons an Acorn (5 HP, not a Seedling) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it gains 10 max HP and heals 10, without limit. Crush (r): damage to target enemy equal to half its HP.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and lodges a thorn in them for 2 turns: at the end of each of the user's turns, it deals them 10 damage and the user heals 5, which can Flourish.
Deals 25 damage to all enemies. The user creates a Seedling for each enemy left below 50 HP (max 2).
Target ally heals 10, plus the remaining HP of one of the user's Seedlings or Treants, which is sacrificed; this can Flourish. If the user has none, they create a Seedling.
Summons a Dryad (20 HP) for 3 turns. Mend (nc): target ally heals 15, which can Flourish.
For 4 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, every allied minion heals 15, which can Flourish; if the user has no minion, they create a Seedling. Channeled.
Sacrifices one of the user's Seedlings, if they have one, to deal 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; otherwise it deals 10 damage and the user creates a Seedling.
Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Against a Stunned target, 10 of their max HP moves to the user, counting toward the user's Flourish limit.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it lands on the user's minions instead of its targets. With no minion to take it, it's countered and the user creates a Boulder. Invisible.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy and roots them: a Seedling sprouts for the user, and the target is Stunned for 2 turns, or until that Seedling dies.
For 3 turns, at the start of each of the user's turns, they heal 10, which can Flourish, and gain 1 Swiftness if they're above their starting max HP.
Target ally heals 20, which can Flourish. If any of it Flourishes, the user creates a Seedling.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their max HP rises by 20; the extra HP arrives filled and leaves when it ends.
Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns, and meanwhile their skills can't target the user's minions.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Every ally heals 5, which can Flourish.
All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, damage dealt to any unit on the user's side is split evenly among all of them, minions included.
Deals 10 damage to all enemies, doubled against minions. Each enemy minion it kills becomes a Seedling for the user.
If there's no allied Seedling that hasn't Bloomed yet, the user creates one. Then every allied Seedling Blooms now, and every allied minion heals to full.
The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. When it ends, whatever is left heals the user, which can Flourish.
Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns by one of the user's minions, or by the user if they have none. A Seedling that survives it Blooms when it ends.
For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and 1 Armor per allied minion, and allied minions are Untargetable.

kits.name: Divine
kits.tagline: Holy made absolute: one light that heals whoever it touches on your side and burns whoever it touches on theirs.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy made absolute: one light that heals whoever it touches on your side and burns whoever it touches on theirs.
kits.playsLike: Always useful: heal or smite as the turn needs

keywords.text: Counts as Anointed. The bearer's Radiant skills reach both sides: used on an ally, they also hit a random enemy; used on an enemy, they also help the ally with the least HP.
A Radiant skill can target any unit and says what it does to an ally and to an enemy. It counts as Helpful on allies and Harmful on enemies, for counters and Traps.

rows.effect: Radiant. Enemy: 20 damage. Ally: heals 20. If its last use was on the other side, 10 more, and the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If the user is Exalted, it's spent to bring the Hammer down on both sides: every ally also heals 25.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. If the target is Condemned, it triggers now, and the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and the ally with the least HP heals the damage it would have dealt. Invisible.

For 3 turns, each time the user deals direct damage to an enemy, the ally with the least HP heals half as much; each time the user heals someone, that healing included, a random enemy takes half as much.
Radiant. Enemy: 15 damage; until the user's next turn, allies who damage them heal 5. Ally: heals 15; until then, enemies who damage them are Condemned.
On the following turn, deals 35 damage to target enemy, plus 10 for each time an ally of the user is healed meanwhile (max 30 more). The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
For 3 turns, the first Helpful skill target enemy uses is diverted: its effects land on the user's ally with the least HP instead. Invisible.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If they're Anointed, it's spent, and they're Exalted until the end of their next turn.
Summons a Seraph (40 HP) permanently. Burning Light (W): 15 damage to target enemy, and they're Condemned. Whenever a Condemn it applied triggers, the Seraph Sanctifies that enemy for 1 turn.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Marks them for 1 turn. Every Invisible effect in the battle is revealed and ends, on both sides, the user's own included.
Deals 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. The user is Exalted for 1 turn, plus 1 more turn for each enemy it leaves below half HP (max 3 turns).
Deals 5 damage to target enemy; the user heals 10. If the target is Sanctified, it's spent and the user is Exalted for 2 turns; otherwise the target is Sanctified for 2 turns.
Summons a Harbinger (20 HP) for 3 turns. While it lives, the user is Exalted. Trumpet (W): 10 damage to all enemies.
For 2 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy who isn't Sanctified takes 10 damage and is Sanctified for 1 turn; then every ally heals 5 per Sanctified enemy. Channeled.
Radiant. Enemy: 10 damage, or 20 if they have more HP than the user. Ally: heals 10, or 20 if they have less HP than the user.
Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Until the end of the user's next turn, their skills don't spend their Anointed.
Radiant, for 1 turn. Enemy: if they use a Harmful skill, it's countered. Ally: the first Harmful skill used on them is countered. Either way, the countered skill's user is Condemned. Invisible.
Radiant. Enemy: Stunned for 1 turn, then Condemned when it ends. Ally: loses all Stuns and gains 1 Swiftness for 2 turns.
For 2 turns, the user is Invulnerable and Immune and their healing is doubled, but they can only use Helpful skills.
Target ally heals to full HP and loses all their Debuffs.
Radiant. Ally: for 2 turns, each enemy they hit is Condemned. Enemy: for 2 turns, each ally of the user who hits them is Anointed until the end of their next turn.
Radiant. Enemy: Condemned, and every Debuff on the user's ally with the least HP moves onto them. Ally: their Debuffs move onto the enemy with the most HP, who is Condemned.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each unit they hit heals 10 afterward.
All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Healing past an ally's max HP instead deals that much damage to a random enemy.
Radiant. Hits the target and one random unit on the other side: enemies take 15 damage, allies heal 15.
For 1 turn, no unit on either side can use Harmful skills. Bypass.
The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns, and is Anointed while any of it remains.
Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, the user is Exalted until the end of their next turn.
For 3 turns, the user is Exalted and gains 2 Armor. Whenever they Condemn an enemy, a random ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

kits.name: Evil
kits.tagline: Unholy with nothing held back: it poisons healing itself, and spends souls like coin.
kits.taglineHtml: Unholy with nothing held back: it poisons healing itself, and spends souls like coin.
kits.playsLike: Punishes healers, feeds on souls

keywords.text: Any healing the bearer would receive, including Renew and Lifesteal, deals that much Affliction damage to them instead.
The skill spends up to that many of the user's Soul Fragments for its listed bonus. It still works with none.

rows.effect: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If they were healed since the user's last turn, they take 10 more and are Unhallowed for 2 turns.

Deals 25 damage to target enemy and grinds them for 2 turns: at the end of each of the user's turns, they take 10 Affliction damage, each of their allies takes 5, and the user drains a Soul Fragment from them.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and drains a Soul Fragment from them. If an enemy hits the user before their next turn, that enemy drains a Soul Fragment back from the user.
For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user. If the user dies before the end of their next turn, the last enemy it countered dies with them. Invisible.
For 2 turns, the user is Immortal, and each enemy who damages them loses a Soul Fragment to the user.
If the user has a Soul Fragment to spend, they hurl it: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Otherwise, deals 10 damage to target enemy and drains a Soul Fragment from them.
In 3 turns, deals 70 Affliction damage to target enemy. Each time they're healed meanwhile, it lands a turn sooner. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
For 2 turns, the first time target enemy would be healed, they take that much Affliction damage instead and are Stunned for 1 turn. Invisible.
The user gains a Soul Fragment. For 1 turn, each time they'd lose HP, they lose a Soul Fragment instead; once they have none left, HP is lost as usual.
Summons a Fiend (35 HP) permanently. Rend Soul (S): 15 Affliction damage and Unhallowed for 1 turn. Feast (r): drains a Soul Fragment from a Horrified enemy for its summoner.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each Buff they gain costs them 10 HP.
Deals 45 damage to all enemies. Then the user and each of their allies are Unhallowed for 2 turns.
Every enemy takes 5 damage and is Horrified for 1 turn. The user drains a Soul Fragment from the one with the least HP and heals 10.
Summons a Tormentor (25 HP) for 3 turns. Barbed Whip (r): 10 Affliction damage. False Mercy (I): target enemy is Unhallowed for 1 turn; if it takes hold, they then heal 15.
For 3 turns, deals 10 damage to target enemy each turn, with Lifesteal. While it channels, the user is Immortal, but only this Lifesteal can heal them. Channeled.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If that leaves them at or below 30 HP, they're Unhallowed for 2 turns, so no healing can save them.
Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy. The user pays in blood instead of energy: they lose 25 HP, which can't kill them.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered, and its targets take the healing it would have given as Affliction damage. Invisible.
Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns, but Immortal for as long: nothing can take them below 5 HP meanwhile.
Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy, and the user gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns. For those 2 turns, the user's Confusion lowers their skill costs instead of raising them.
Target ally heals 35. At the end of each of their next 2 turns, they lose 10 HP unless they damaged an enemy that turn.
The user gives up 1 Soul Fragment, and target ally gains 2; after 2 turns, one of them crumbles away. With none to give up, the user pays 15 HP instead, and both crumble away after 2 turns.
Target enemy gains 1 Confusion and is Immortal for 3 turns. Each hit that would have taken them below 5 HP gives its dealer a Soul Fragment.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Tithe 1: for 2 turns, each ally who damages them gains a Soul Fragment.
All allies heal 25. Then each ally at full HP gives 10 of it back to gain 1 Soul Fragment.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy, and their agony spills onto their allies: each takes 5 Affliction damage for every 20 HP the target is now missing (at least 5, at most 15).
All enemies are Unhallowed until the end of their next turn; any of them healed during it are also Horrified for 2 turns.
The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, plus 10 drained as Affliction damage from each Unhallowed or Horrified enemy.
Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. While they're Taunted, the user is Immortal.
For 3 turns, the user gains Lifesteal and 1 Armor per Soul Fragment they have (max 4), but can't spend Soul Fragments.

kits.name: Dimension
kits.tagline: Shadow folded into space: pull a unit out of the fight, or tie two together so one effect lands twice.
kits.taglineHtml: Shadow folded into space: pull a unit out of the fight, or tie two together so one effect lands twice.
kits.playsLike: Takes a unit out of play; makes one effect count twice

keywords.text: Out of the fight: can't act or be targeted by anyone, takes no damage, and their effects neither tick nor expire.
Linked to other units on the same side; any effect applied to one is applied to the others too.

rows.effect: Deals 10 damage to target enemy. Time folds: this doesn't use up the user's turn, so they can use another skill this turn.
Deals 30 damage to target enemy and 20 to their allies; then the user is Banished.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, Bypassing. The user gains Stealth at the start of their next turn unless an enemy targets them first.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and its user is Banished. Invisible.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune. Each time a skill of theirs ends their Stealth, its targets are Blinded for 1 turn. Stealthy.
Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Entangled, their partners take it too; if not, they're Entangled with a random ally for 2 turns.
On the following turn, deals 40 damage to target enemy. Channeling and landing it don't end the user's Stealth. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled, Stealthy.
For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Helpful skill, its target is Banished instead of helped. Invisible.
The user is Banished, and so is the last enemy who damaged them.
Summons a Void Stalker (30 HP) permanently. Tether (r): target enemy and a random ally of theirs are Entangled for 2 turns. Rend (r): 10 Piercing damage, and Entangled partners take it too.
Deals 30 damage to target enemy, but the dark matter swallows the light around the user too: they're Blinded for 1 turn.
Deals 25 damage to all enemies; then the one with the most HP is Banished.
Deals 10 Affliction damage to all enemies, and a random one of them who isn't Blinded is Blinded for 1 turn.
Summons a Rift (20 HP) for 3 turns. Shunt (I): target enemy is Isolated for 1 turn, or Banished if they already were.
For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, deals 10 damage to all enemies, and a random ally's Debuff trades places with a random enemy's Buff. Channeled.

Deals 10 damage to target enemy and leaves a cut in them until the end of the user's next turn. If the user knifes a different enemy meanwhile, the old cut opens through the fold: its bearer takes 10 too.
Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; any Blind or Isolation on them lasts 2 turns longer.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they're Entangled with a random ally for 2 turns; then they're Isolated for 1 turn, so both are. Invisible.
Target enemy is Banished. When they return, they're out of phase with the world: Blinded for 1 turn.
The user is Banished. When they return, they gain Stealth, and Ghosted and 1 Focus for 2 turns.
Target ally is Banished. When they return, they heal 30 and lose their Debuffs.
Target ally gains 2 Might for 2 turns, but they're out of phase with their own side meanwhile: Isolated.
Target enemy and a random ally of theirs are Entangled for 3 turns. Each time either uses a skill, the other gains 1 Confusion, so both do.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, the user's side can target them even if they're Stealthed, Untargetable or Invulnerable.
All allies heal 20 and are Entangled together for 2 turns, but only Buffs pass through this link.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. The other half of the cut hangs in the fold: the first of their allies to use a skill before the user's next turn takes 15.
All enemies are Entangled together for 2 turns, then Blinded for 1 turn.
The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Damage it absorbs is folded across: the ally with the least HP gains that much Shield for 1 turn.
Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 1 turn, and every other unit on both sides, minions included, is Banished: the two fight alone.
For 3 turns, the user is Entangled with the ally with the least HP, then gains 2 Armor and Immune, so that ally does too.

kits.name: Apocalypse
kits.tagline: The world ending both ways at once, and the shock where fire meets ice.
kits.taglineHtml: The world ending both ways at once, and the shock where fire meets ice.
kits.playsLike: Alternate fire and ice for combo damage

keywords.text: Counts as both an Ignite and Chilled. Takes 5 Affliction damage at the end of the applier's turn, and can't have skill costs reduced.

When a unit with a Fire debuff (Ignite, Scorched, Frostfire) gains a Frost debuff (Frostbitten, Chilled, Numb, Frostfire), or the reverse, it takes 15 Piercing damage and is Shattered for 1 turn. Once per unit per turn.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. They're Ignited if they have a Frost debuff, otherwise Frostbitten for 1 turn.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, then the target gains Frostfire. If that Thermal Shocks them, each of their allies with a Fire or Frost debuff is Shocked too.

Deals 15 damage to target enemy, who gains Frostfire, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. If that skill hits an enemy who's Chilled and Ignited (Frostfire is both), the cold cracks the Ignite: it ticks twice at once.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and the spines splinter outward: every other enemy gains Frostfire. Invisible.
For 4 turns, the user swings between extremes: 3 Might on their first and third turns, and 3 Armor and Immune on their second and fourth.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy and leaves a spark in them until the end of the user's next turn. Hitting them with it again while the spark is there sets it off: they're Thermal Shocked.
On the following turn, deals 45 damage to target enemy. If they gain a Fire or Frost debuff first, it lands at once and Thermal Shocks them. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
For 3 turns, the first time target enemy falls to 50 HP or less, the ice cracks under them: they take 20 Piercing damage and are Stunned for 1 turn. Invisible.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and for 1 more turn after that, Invulnerable to enemies with a Fire debuff.
Summons a Rimeflame Salamander (35 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it gives a random enemy Frostfire. When it dies, every enemy with Frostfire is Thermal Shocked.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy, who gains Frostfire. If they already had it, the paradox Thermal Shocks them, even if they were already Shocked this turn.
Deals 20 damage to all enemies. Each Ignite on them turns into Frostfire, Thermal Shocking its bearer; each enemy with no Fire debuff is Ignited instead.

Deals 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user as much. If they have both a Fire and a Frost debuff (Frostfire counts as both), the extremes cancel out: all their Fire and Frost debuffs end, and the user heals 10 for each one that ended.
Summons a Twilight Jotunn (60 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 25 damage to a random enemy. While it stands, the user is Stunned; Swiftness can't stop it.

For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, deals 10 damage to all enemies. The first Ignites them all; the second Chills them all for 1 turn; the third makes every Ignited enemy Explode. Channeled.
Deals 5 damage to target enemy and Shatters them for the rest of the turn, then deals 10 more.
Deals 20 Affliction damage to target enemy, +10 for each Fire or Frost debuff they have. Then those debuffs are removed.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain Frostfire. A Helpful skill Scorches and Numbs them for 1 turn instead. Invisible.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, who gains Frostfire and is Stunned for 1 turn. If the Frostfire is still on them when the Stun ends, it's consumed to Stun them 1 more turn.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and Explodes at the end of each of their turns in which they dealt damage.
Target ally heals 35 at the end of the enemy's next turn. If a hit would kill them before then, the heal lands first, at once.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their direct damage deals 10 more to Shattered enemies.
Target enemy gains Frostfire, then 1 Confusion for 2 turns per Fire or Frost debuff they have, Frostfire included (max 3).
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, who's Sanctified for 1 turn. For 2 turns, each time they use a Harmful skill, they're Frostbitten for 1 turn.
All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 2 turns, Chilled enemies' skills also cost 1 more random energy.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who also gains copies of the target's Fire and Frost debuffs.
All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and a random one gains Frostfire. For as long, each enemy with Frostfire is Intimidated twice over.
The user gains 30 Shield until the end of their next turn. Then the heart thaws: whatever is left of it bursts onto a random enemy as that much damage, and they gain Frostfire.
Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 2 turns, and every Fire and Frost debuff on their allies moves onto them.
For 3 turns, the user is Immune, and the first enemy they deal direct damage to on each of their turns is Thermal Shocked, but they're Shattered meanwhile.

kits.name: Alchemy
kits.tagline: Fire and water in the crucible: nothing is destroyed, only changed.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire and water in the crucible: nothing is destroyed, only changed.
kits.playsLike: Converts the board: their buffs become your weapons

keywords.text: The next skill that affects the bearer is doubled for them: twice the damage, healing, and the stacks and duration of what it applies.

Turns effects on a unit into others, stack for stack. On enemies, Might becomes Weakness, Armor becomes Vulnerable, Focus becomes Confusion, and Renew becomes Weakness; on allies, the reverse, and other Debuffs become Renew.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Their Ignite ticks at once, plus once more for each Buff they have (max 3 more).
Deals 25 damage to target enemy. The kiln's heat washes over their allies instead of hurting them: each gains Catalyst.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. The user gains 1 Renew for each Ignited enemy (max 3).

For 1 turn, the first Harmful skill used on the user shatters the flask: it's countered, and its user is splashed: their Might, Armor, Focus and Renew are Transmuted, and they gain Catalyst. Invisible.
For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, and gains Catalyst at the start of each of their turns.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and Ignites them. For 2 turns, if that Ignite is removed from them, they Explode.
On the following turn, deals 40 damage to target enemy, plus the total healing they received in the meantime. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they gain Catalyst. If they already had it, it reacts instead: they Explode. Invisible.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Their Debuffs are removed, and for each one, a random enemy gains Catalyst.
Summons a Homunculus (30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, one stack of Might, Armor, Focus or Renew on a random enemy is Transmuted, and a random ally gains 1 Renew.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If they have Catalyst, the doubled hit also Transmutes one of their Buffs; if not, they gain Catalyst.
Deals 20 damage to all enemies. Each enemy with Catalyst Explodes.

Deals 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Then 10 of their max HP is distilled into the user: theirs drops by 10 and the user's rises by 10 for the rest of the match (up to 30 per enemy).
Summons an Alembic (15 HP) for 3 turns. Brew (nc) gives target unit, ally or enemy, Catalyst.

For up to 3 turns, the brew concentrates at the end of each of the user's turns. When it ends, run its course or broken early (using another skill breaks it), it's released all at once: 10 damage to every enemy and 5 healing to every ally per turn it brewed. Channeled.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy. If they have more Buffs than Debuffs, the lancet Transmutes one of their Buffs (one with no recipe is removed); if not, it finds a weak spot: 10 more damage.
Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. The user boils off all their Renew, and the target's Ignite ticks once per stack (max 4).
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's Transmuted: it's countered, and its targets take 15 Affliction damage and are Weakened for 1 turn instead. Invisible.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and Stuns them for 1 turn; Swiftness can't stop it: each Swiftness on them is Transmuted into 1 Confusion instead.
The user gains Catalyst. At the start of their next turn, they gain 1 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus for 3 turns, doubled if the Catalyst is still unspent.
Target ally heals 15; their Debuffs are Transmuted into 2 Renew each.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their Normal damage is Piercing.
All of target enemy's Buffs are Transmuted; any without a recipe are removed.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, who gains Catalyst. For 1 turn, each ally skill that damages them gives them Catalyst again.
All allies heal 15. Every Renew on enemies is Transmuted into Weakness, and each ally gains 1 Renew per 2 stacks converted.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy, who is Weakened for 1 turn. The potion splashes onto every other enemy: 5 damage for each Debuff on the target (up to 15).
For 1 turn, every Buff an enemy gains is Transmuted on arrival.

Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 2 turns. Meanwhile, half the damage they deal the user is Transmuted into healing for the user.
For the rest of the match, the user has 2 Armor and Immune, but can't gain any other Buff.

kits.name: Plasma
kits.tagline: Fire and lightning past their limits: power you ride until it melts down.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire and lightning past their limits: power you ride until it melts down.
kits.playsLike: Push your luck, then time the meltdown

keywords.text: The bearer's Plasma skills deal 5 more damage per Heat. At the end of their turn with 5 Heat, they Melt Down.
At the end of a Plasma character's turn with 5 Heat: they take 20 Affliction, every enemy takes 20 Affliction and is Sapped, and their Heat returns to 0.
Removes all the user's Heat, for the benefit the skill lists per Heat removed.

passives.name: Plasma Core
passives.text: Gains 1 Heat whenever this character gains Charge. At the end of their turn with 5 Heat, they Melt Down: they take 20 Affliction, every enemy takes 20 Affliction and is Sapped, and Heat returns to 0.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. +1 Heat; or, if the user already has 4 or more, Vent instead for 5 more damage per Heat removed.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Until they end, the Ignites on every enemy it hits deal double.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. +2 Heat, then Vent: the user's next skill costs 1 less per 2 Heat removed.
For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user. Vent: its user takes 10 Affliction damage per Heat removed and is Ignited. Invisible.
+2 Heat. For 3 turns, the user can't Melt Down, and gains 1 Heat at the start of each of their turns. If they're at 5 Heat when it ends, they Melt Down then.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy and arcs to a random other enemy for 10. +1 Heat.

For up to 3 turns, the user charges the coil. When the channel ends (the user uses another skill, or 3 turns pass), it deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 for each turn it was held. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
For 3 turns, the first time target enemy is healed, they're Scorched for 2 turns and they Explode. Invisible.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Vent: they gain 10 Shield per Heat removed, for 1 turn.

Summons a Ball Lightning (25 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy and gives the user 1 Heat. Detonate (r): it dies, dealing 20 damage to all enemies and Sapping them.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Ignites them. This Ignite deals 5 more per Heat the user has when it's applied. +1 Heat.
Deals 20 damage to all enemies. The user Melts Down at the end of this turn, whatever their Heat.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy and Saps them. Vent: the user heals 10 per Heat removed; if they had none, they gain 2 Heat instead.
Summons 2 Jumper Sparks (10 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, each deals 10 damage to a random enemy and gives a random ally 1 Charge.
For up to 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, deals 10 damage to all enemies and Ignites a random one; then every enemy's Ignite ticks at once, and the user gains 1 Charge. Channeled.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. Vent: that threshold rises by 10 HP per Heat removed.
Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each Charge the user spends on it (all of it). Each Charge spent becomes 1 Heat.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Ignited. For 2 turns, that Ignite also ticks at the start of their own turns. Invisible.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. Vent: for every 2 Heat removed, a random other enemy is stunned the same way.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Stormborn, and can't be Stunned while they have 3 or more Heat.
Target ally heals 20. Vent: they gain 1 Charge per 2 Heat removed.
Target ally's Charge fills to 3 at once, and they gain 1 Might for 3 turns. For those 3 turns, they can't gain Charge.
For 2 turns, each skill target enemy uses surges back through them: they take 5 Affliction damage per energy in its cost.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and brands them for 1 turn. Each time an ally damages them meanwhile, the brand heats up by 10; when it ends, it bursts for that much Affliction damage.
All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield for 1 turn. If the user Melts Down before their next turn, the Meltdown heals every ally 20 and doesn't hurt the user.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Any channel either of them holds is broken, and neither can start one until the user's next turn.
All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and every minion in the battle, on both sides, is Stunned for 2 turns.
The user gains 50 Shield for 1 turn. The surge costs them: their next skill costs 2 more energy.
Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 1 turn. Vent: 1 more turn if any Heat was removed, and 1 Sapped per 2 Heat removed.
The user's Heat rises by 2, to at most 4. For 3 turns, they gain Immune and 1 Armor per Heat they have, checked as each hit lands.

kits.name: Mechanic
kits.tagline: Fire in the boiler, wind in the bellows: machines you build, tune and send into the fight.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire in the boiler, wind in the bellows: machines you build, tune and send into the fight.
kits.playsLike: A small workshop of machines, built and tuned

keywords.text: A machine. Can't be healed or gain Renew (only Repair restores it), and ignores Stun, Sleep and Confusion.
Upgrade level (max 3). +5 damage per level (each level also gave +10 max HP).

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, and a random allied minion is Upgraded.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If the user is Rushing, it vents: their Rushing ends, and the splash is 30 and Ignites.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. The user begins Rushing and leaves a Turret behind for 2 turns.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Isolated for 1 turn, and the user builds a Turret. Invisible.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and 1 more Might each time their side causes an Explosion (max 3 more).
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If the last one to damage them was an allied minion, that minion is Upgraded.
The user builds a Mortar (Contraption, 20 HP). On the following turn, if it still stands, it fires: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. Channeled.
For 3 turns, the first skill target enemy uses Ignites them; after that, their Ignite also ticks each time they use a skill. Invisible.
The user takes to the air: Invulnerable for 2 turns, but they can't use skills on their next turn. When the flight ends, they come down with an Explosion.
Builds a Clockwork Hound (Contraption, 30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy, and every other turn it Upgrades itself.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Marks them for 1 turn. Until the end of their next turn, they're hooked: they lose Invulnerable, Untargetable and Stealth, and can't gain them.
Deals 20 damage to all enemies, +10 for each ally of the user who used a skill earlier this turn.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user as much. The user burns all their Swiftness as fuel: 10 more healing per stack.
Builds 2 Turrets for 3 turns. When one is destroyed, the other is Upgraded.
For up to 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, a random allied minion is Upgraded; if the user has none, they build a Turret instead. Channeled.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, 5 more for each earlier Drill Bit still in them (up to 10 more): the hole only gets deeper. Usable while Stunned.
Deals Piercing damage to target enemy equal to a third of their current HP (at least 10, at most 25): the saw bites deepest into the thickest hide.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and a Dummy (Contraption, 15 HP) is built. When the Dummy is destroyed, it Explodes. Invisible.
Lands at the start of the user's next turn: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun to target enemy, unless they used a mobility skill in between.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and runs overclocked: at the end of each of their turns, their cooldowns tick down 1 extra turn, and the engine burns them for 5 Affliction damage.
Target ally heals 20. An allied minion is instead Upgraded twice; a Contraption is Repaired for 20 first.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their damaging skills don't end their Leap; it ends only when they take damage.
Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each mobility skill they use backfires: it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each allied minion that damages them is Upgraded.
All allies heal 20. Each ally at or below half HP afterwards gets a Turret for 2 turns.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. The user overheats: they're Ignited, and deal 5 more direct damage while they stay Ignited.
All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Every allied minion is Upgraded, and loses that level again after 2 turns.
The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, if 10 or more is left, the user builds a Turret for 2 turns from it.
Builds a Decoy (Contraption, 20 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns, or 3 if they're Immobile.

For 3 turns, the user climbs into the suit and counts as a Contraption: Immune, ignores Stuns and can't be healed, and it's Upgraded now and at the start of each of their turns. When the suit comes off, so do its Upgrades.

kits.name: Brimstone
kits.tagline: Sulfur and hellfire: pack the enemy with fuel, then light it.
kits.taglineHtml: Sulfur and hellfire: pack the enemy with fuel, then light it.
kits.playsLike: Load them up, then light the fuse

keywords.text: Max 4. Does nothing on its own. When the bearer takes Ignite damage or is hit by an Explosion, it Erupts: 10 Affliction per stack to them and 5 per stack to each of their allies, and every stack turns into 1 Toxin.
A unit's Sulfur Erupts: 10 Affliction per stack to them and 5 per stack to each of their allies, and every stack turns into 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, who gains 1 Sulfur. If that brings them to 4, their Sulfur Erupts at once.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. For 2 turns, Explosions deal 10 more to each enemy it hit.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. Until the user's next turn, Toxin on the target also ticks at the start of the target's turn.

For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and every Ignited or Scorched enemy counts as Prey.
Deals 5 Piercing damage to target enemy, who gains 1 Sulfur. If they're Prey or already had Sulfur, it all Erupts.
On the following turn, the burning javelin lands: target enemy gains 2 Sulfur, then their Sulfur Erupts. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled, Uncounterable.

Summons a Belching Toad (30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it swallows a Debuff from a random ally and belches it onto a random enemy.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Marks them for 1 turn. Until the Mark is spent, they count as Prey.
Deals 15 damage to all enemies. Then each one's Ignite ticks once for every 2 Toxin they have (max 3).
Target enemy is Ignited by a hungry flame for 2 turns: it burns for 10 instead of 5, and the user heals for every burn.
Summons 2 Stokers (10 HP) for 2 turns. At the end of each of your turns, each Ignites an enemy with Sulfur; if no enemy has any, it gives a random one 1 Sulfur instead.

For up to 8 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, deals 5 Affliction damage to all enemies, and a random enemy gains 1 Sulfur. When it ends or is broken, every enemy's Sulfur Erupts. Channeled.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy. If that leaves them at or below 40 HP, the user Explodes.
Deals 20 Affliction damage to target enemy, +10 per Toxin on them. Then their Toxin is burned away.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain 1 Sulfur per energy it cost. Invisible.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, who is Stunned for 1 turn. Swiftness, Immune and Unstunnable don't stop it. Bypass.
For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy gains 1 Sulfur and the user gains 1 Swiftness until the dance ends. When it ends, the user Explodes.
Target ally heals 20, and their Toxin is drawn off; a random enemy gains that much Sulfur.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and Flameborn, and their Flameborn heals them for all the Affliction damage they deal, not just their Ignites'.
Target enemy's Toxin turns into Sulfur, stack for stack (max 4), and they're Confused for 2 turns.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, who gains 2 Sulfur. For 1 turn, allies who damage them heal 5 per Sulfur on them.

Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who gains as much Sulfur as the target has.
All enemies gain 1 Sulfur. For 2 turns, whenever Sulfur the user gave is cleansed away, its bearer takes 10 Affliction damage instead.
The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. If an enemy breaks it, the user becomes Flameborn for 2 turns.
Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 2 turns. Whenever another enemy uses a Helpful skill meanwhile, the Taunt jumps to them.
For 3 turns, the user gains Immune, and every hit on them burns its dealer: each enemy who deals them direct damage gains 1 Sulfur and is Ignited.

kits.name: Sun
kits.tagline: Fire over earth: a star that scorches the enemy and ripens everything on your side.

kits.playsLike: A slow-burning star on your side of the board

keywords.text: Max 3. At the end of the applier's turn, every enemy takes 5 Affliction per stack and every ally heals 5 per stack.
A Flare skill spends all the user's Corona for the bonus it lists per stack.

Halves the Shield of target enemy and their allies, then deals 20 damage to the target and 10 to their allies. Those who had no Shield are Scorched for 1 turn instead.

Deals 10 damage to target enemy and sets a Sunstone rolling: a Boulder (20 HP) that, at the start of the user's next turn, crashes into them for its remaining HP. It Explodes when it crashes or is destroyed.

Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has no Corona, they gain 1; otherwise it Flares: 10 more per Corona.
On the following turn, deals 45 damage to target enemy. Flare: when it lands, every ally heals 10 per Corona spent. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
For 3 turns, each time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they take 10 damage and the user creates a Seedling (up to 3). Invisible.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. At the start of their next turn they rise: they gain 1 Corona, and each enemy who used a Harmful skill meanwhile is Ignited.
Summons a Sunflower (40 HP, counts as a Seedling) permanently; it always has 1 Corona. Scatter Seeds (r): the Sunflower loses 10 HP and creates a Seedling.

Deals 25 damage to all enemies. Flare: 10 more to each per Corona, but the user is Scorched for 1 turn per Corona spent.
Deals 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it, 10 more if the target is Ignited. The user gains 1 Corona, and all their Corona lasts 2 turns longer.
Summons a Sunseed (20 HP) for 3 turns with 1 Corona. When it dies or expires, its creator gains its Corona. Brighten (r): the Sunseed gains 1 Corona.
For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Corona. While it channels, their Corona doesn't expire and deals double to Ignited enemies. Channeled.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and Ignites them, and the spark catches the user too: they're Ignited as well.
Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each of the user's turns since they last dealt direct damage (max +30).
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Blinded for 1 turn per Corona the user has (at least 1). Invisible.
Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn and Ignited. Flare: 1 more turn of Stun per 2 Corona.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness, and each time their Corona ticks they gain 1 Might for 1 turn. They gain 1 Corona now.
Target ally heals 20. Each Ignite or Scorch on them is removed and becomes 1 Corona.
For 3 turns, target ally gains the sun's light (as 1 Might and 1 Renew). At the start of each of the user's turns, it moves to the ally with the least HP.
Target enemy is Scorched for 2 turns; the healing the Scorch denies them goes to a random ally of the user instead.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Flare: for 1 turn per Corona spent, allies who damage them gain 1 Corona.
All allies heal 20. Flare: every ally gains 1 Corona per 2 Corona spent, rounded up.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Then the fire runs to whichever of them has more HP left: 10 more damage, and they're Ignited.
All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Every allied minion gains 1 Corona, and it ticks once now.
The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. Each time it absorbs damage, the heat is banked: the user gains 1 Corona.
Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 2 turns. For as long, no other enemy can target the user.
For 3 turns, the user is Immune and swells: at the start of each of their turns, they gain 15 max HP and heal 15. When it ends, they lose that max HP, and every enemy takes as much damage.

kits.name: Phoenix
kits.tagline: A holy flame that burns its foes, mends its friends, and rises from its own ashes.

kits.playsLike: Burn the foe, mend the friend, rise again

keywords.text: When the bearer would die, they burn to Ashes instead, and Rebirth ends.
Until the start of the bearer's next turn, they're Untargetable and can't lose HP. Then they rise, back up to 25 HP if they have less.
A Kindle skill can target an enemy or an ally. On an enemy it burns, dealing its damage and its Ignite; on an ally it mends: the damage becomes healing and each Ignite becomes 2 Renew.

The user dives in as a living pyre: they burn up to 40 of their own HP, never below 1. Target enemy takes that much damage, and each of their allies half as much. The user rises from the plunge with Rebirth for 1 turn.

Deals 15 damage to target enemy, or heals target ally 15. The user rises from the dive with Rebirth until their next skill lands (for up to 2 turns); if it's still unspent then, that skill also deals 15 more damage to its first target if they're an enemy, or heals them 15 more if they're an ally.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. If its user is Ignited, the Ignite burns once at once, and the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn. Invisible.
For 3 turns, the user's fury catches: each enemy they deal direct damage to is Ignited, and their direct damage is 5 more for each Ignited enemy.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy and lodges an ember in them for 1 turn: the next direct hit they take from the user's side deals 10 more and Ignites them.
On the following turn, the sun falls on target enemy: 35 damage to them and 15 to each of their allies. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
For 3 turns, the first time target enemy kills a unit or sends one to Ashes, the nest flares: they take 25 damage and are Ignited. Invisible.
The user sinks into the embers: until the start of their next turn, they're Untargetable by allies and enemies alike and can't lose HP. They come back out with the HP they had.
Summons a Phoenix Chick (15 HP) permanently. Peck (r): 10 damage and Ignite. The first time it dies, it rises at the end of your next turn as a Firebird (30 HP) whose Peck deals 20.
Kindle: 20 damage and Ignite to target enemy, or 20 healing and 2 Renew to target ally. An ally it mends also loses 1 Debuff.
Deals 25 damage to all enemies, and they lose all their Buffs. Then every ally of the user, the user included, loses all their Debuffs.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy. If they still have more HP than the user, the user draws on their brighter flame and heals half the difference (at most 25).
Summons an Ember Spirit (20 HP) for 3 turns. Waver (r): Kindle, 15 damage and Ignite to target enemy, or 15 healing and 2 Renew to target ally.
For up to 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, the pyre burns all enemies, growing as it burns: 5 damage, then 10, then 15. Channeled.

On target enemy, 15 damage, and their wounds are seared shut: they can't be healed until the end of their next turn. On target ally, the needle cauterizes: up to 2 of their Debuffs burn away, and they lose 10 HP for each (never below 1).
Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, plus 5 for every 10 HP the user is missing (at most 30 more): the nearer the pyre, the hotter the talon.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and their Ignite flares: it burns three times at once. Invisible.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and Stuns them for 2 turns, wrapped in cinders: while they're Stunned, they can't lose HP.
For 4 turns, the user gains 2 Swiftness, and each skill they use meanwhile leaves an ember. When the dance ends, the embers burst: each one deals 10 damage to every enemy and heals every ally 5.
The user burns up to 30 of their own HP, never below 1. Target ally heals twice what was burned.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and Rebirth. If the Rebirth goes unused, it burns off when this ends: they heal 25.

Target enemy is Ignited, and for 3 turns the fire breeds doubt: at the end of each of the user's turns, if they're still Ignited, they randomly gain 1 Weakness or 1 Vulnerable for 1 turn, or 1 Confusion.

Deals 20 damage to target enemy and lays them on a pyre for 1 turn: it counts as Sanctify, but rather than heal their attackers, each direct hit they take stokes it. When it ends, they burn for 15 Affliction damage per hit.
Every fallen ally of the user returns with 20 HP and no Buffs or Debuffs. Then all allies heal 15.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, and fans the flames between them for 1 turn: each direct hit either of them takes also burns the other for 5.
For 2 turns, each enemy who deals direct damage to an ally of the user is Ignited, and the ally they hurt gains 1 Renew.
The user gains 40 Shield and can't act on their next turn. When the cocoon opens, the user and every ally heal as much as the Shield has left.
Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 1 turn. Each time they hit the user meanwhile, every other ally of the user heals 10.
For 3 turns, the user gains Immune, and their wounds rekindle: each direct hit they take gives them 1 Renew for every 10 damage, up to 3 Renew at a time.

kits.name: Devil
kits.tagline: Fire and damnation: everything is for sale, and the bill always comes.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire and damnation: everything is for sale, and the bill always comes.
kits.playsLike: Deals for allies, tempting gifts for enemies

A deal with a due date. When it expires, the Devil collects the price.

Deals 15 damage to target enemy. An Ignite on them becomes Hellfire for 2 turns; if they already had Hellfire, the user gains 1 Soul Fragment.

For 1 turn, each hit on the user goes on their tab instead: a Contract whose price, at the end of their next turn, is half that damage as Affliction. Invisible.

Summons an Imp Notary (25 HP) permanently. Offer (I): target unit gets a Contract (2 turns): 1 Might now; price: 10 Affliction damage. Sealing Wax (r): 10 Affliction damage, and Hellfire on a Contract holder.
Deals 35 damage to target enemy on credit: the user takes a Contract (2 turns) whose price is 15 Affliction damage, waived if that enemy has died by then.
Deals 20 damage to all enemies. The user spends all their Soul Fragments (up to 3), and every enemy gains Hellfire for 1 turn per fragment spent.
Deals 5 damage to target enemy and puts them in debt to the user: a Contract (2 turns) whose price is 20 Affliction damage, and the user heals as much as it deals.
Summons an Imp Captain (25 HP) for 3 turns. Ember Whip (r): 10 damage to target enemy. Its hits deal 5 more per Soul Fragment the user has, without spending them.

For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the user gains a Soul Fragment for each Ignite and Scorch they carry. Invisible.

For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and Ignites they apply also burn at the start of each of their turns.

Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If they die within 2 turns, whoever killed them has their cooldowns reset, and the user's player gains 1 random energy.
All allies heal 20, and all enemies are Horrified for 1 turn. For as long, each Helpful skill used on a Horrified enemy (whose Buffs fail) gives a random ally of the user 1 Might instead.
