kits.name: Ritual
kits.tagline: Fire in the dark: candles, circles and rites that pay off only if nobody breaks them.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire in the dark: candles, circles and rites that pay off only if nobody breaks them.
kits.playsLike: Big payoffs the enemy must race to interrupt

keywords.text: Completes once the user (or their Acolytes) have used as many more skills as it has stacks. Breaks if the user is Stunned, falls Asleep or is Banished.

rows.effect: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. Rite (2): the target Explodes.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to the others. Rite (3): every enemy is Ignited and Blinded for 2 turns.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy. Rite (1): the flame catches up with them: they take 15 damage and are Ignited.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and their Rite can't be broken until the end of their next turn. Invisible.
For 3 turns, the user gains Immune, and every unit on both sides gains 2 Might.
Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they have no Buffs (nobody tended them), they're Isolated for 1 turn.
Rite (2): 50 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable, and they're Ignited. The target of this skill is invisible.
For 2 turns, each Harmful skill target enemy uses deals them 10 Affliction damage and advances the user's Rite by 1. Invisible.
For 2 turns, the first time an enemy hits the user, the user bursts into smoke and cinders: they become Invulnerable for 1 turn, and that enemy is Ignited. Stealthy.
Summons a Shadow Acolyte (30 HP) permanently; each skill it uses advances its summoner's Rite. Chant (r): target ally heals 10. Flame Lash (r): 10 damage and Ignite.
Deals 30 damage to target enemy, but the shadowflame's glare takes the user's sight: they're Blinded until the end of their next turn.
Deals 20 damage to all enemies. Rite (3): every enemy takes 10 Affliction damage for each skill they used while it counted.
Target enemy burns as an offering for 2 turns: at the end of each of the user's turns, they take 5 Affliction damage and the user heals 10.
Summons a Wick (15 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy, doubling each time; any damage to it resets it to 10.
For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, deals 10 damage to all enemies and advances the user's Rite by 1. While it lasts, the user can't be Stunned or put to Sleep. Channeled.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if it's the skill that completes the user's Rite.
Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy and Ignites them. Then every Ignite on the enemy team burns once now.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user's Rite completes at once. Invisible.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy. After this, the next time they take damage within 2 turns, they're Stunned for 1 turn.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each skill they use advances their Rite by 1 more.
Target ally heals 15. Rite (2): all allies heal 25.
For 2 turns, target ally Ignites each enemy they damage, and Ignites they apply can stack, up to 2.
For 2 turns, target enemy unknowingly carries a cursed flame: each skill they use Ignites a random ally of theirs. Invisible.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and brands them. Rite (2): the brand is burned as an offering: the user's ally with the least HP heals half of all the direct damage the target took while it counted.
All allies heal 20. Rite (3): every ally who hasn't taken damage since it started heals 30 and gains Stealth.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Until the user's next turn, healing either of them receives is dealt to the other as damage instead.
All enemies are Isolated for 2 turns, each shut inside a ring of ash. Rite (1): the rings catch fire: every enemy who's still Isolated takes 10 Affliction damage.
The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. If any of it is left when the turn is up, the smoke catches fire: a random enemy takes damage equal to what's left.

The user offers up 15 of their HP to raise an Effigy (30 HP), and target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns. If it still stands when the Taunt ends, it burns as an offering: the user heals for half the HP it has left. The user needs more than 15 HP to use it.

For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and burns like a candle that won't go out: their HP can't drop below 1. When it ends, the wax runs off them as fire: every enemy takes 5 Affliction damage for every 20 damage the user took meanwhile (at most 30).

kits.name: Glacier
kits.tagline: Ice that moves at its own pace: freeze the enemy's clock and let yours run.
kits.taglineHtml: Ice that moves at its own pace: freeze the enemy's clock and let yours run.
kits.playsLike: Freeze their clock, speed up yours
kits.notesHtml: A tempo kit: Ice's lockdown aimed at cooldowns, and Water's cooldown relief pushed further.

keywords.text: The bearer's cooldowns don't tick down.
The bearer's cooldowns tick down 1 extra at the end of each of their turns.

rows.effect: Deals 25 damage to target enemy, and they're Icebound for 1 turn. If they already were, the user gains Meltwater for 1 turn instead.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The user spends all their Renew: each stack adds 5 to every hit.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gains Meltwater for 1 turn, or 2 if the target has a skill on cooldown.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; they gain Meltwater for 1 turn per turn of that skill's cooldown (max 3). Invisible.
For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and Meltwater; each time Meltwater brings one of their skills off cooldown, they gain 1 Might until it ends.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. Their skill with the longest cooldown left and the user's other skill with the longest cooldown left swap cooldowns.
On the following turn, deals 50 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Icebound, it lands at once instead, and their Icebound ends. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they're Icebound for 2 turns and their cooldowns rise by 1. Invisible.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and every enemy with a skill on cooldown is Icebound for 1 turn.
Summons a Walrus (45 HP) permanently. Tusk (S): 20 damage to target enemy. Haul Out (r): target ally gains Meltwater for 2 turns, and the Walrus is Icebound for as long.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and steals a turn of thaw: a random skill of theirs still on cooldown gains 1 turn, and a random other skill of the user's still on cooldown loses 1.
Deals 25 damage to all enemies. Every Frost debuff on them thaws: it's removed, and a random ally of the user gains 2 Renew for each.
Deals 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If they're Icebound, it ends, and the user gains Meltwater for 2 turns; otherwise they're Icebound for 1 turn.
Summons an Ice Tongue (50 HP) for 4 turns. It does nothing for its first 2 turns; then, at the end of each of your turns, it deals 30 Piercing damage to a random enemy.
For up to 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, deals 10 damage to target enemy, who is Icebound for 1 turn. While it channels, the user's cooldowns don't tick either. Channeled.

Deals 20 damage to target enemy, paid for in time: a random other skill of the user's still on cooldown gains 1 turn. If none is, the frost settles on the pick instead: it goes on cooldown for 1 turn.
Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 per Confusion they have (max 3). Then their Confusion is washed away.

The user freezes over to wait: they're Icebound for up to 3 turns. Meanwhile, the first Harmful skill target enemy uses breaks through the ice and is countered, and the user thaws: their Icebound ends, and they gain Meltwater for 1 turn. Invisible.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy and Stuns them for 2 turns. The ice locks the user in too: they're Icebound for as long.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and Meltwater, and each ally they use a Helpful skill on gains Meltwater for 1 turn.
Target ally heals 15 and gains Meltwater for 1 turn.
Target ally loses Icebound and Chilled, then gains Meltwater for 2 turns, +1 turn for each of those removed.
Target enemy is Icebound for 2 turns, so whatever skills they have on cooldown stay there until it ends; their cooldowns also rise by 1.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them has their Renew heal once at once, without losing a stack.
All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield for 1 turn. For 2 turns, Frostbitten enemies can't use Helpful skills either.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy. The calved slab drifts on: the next of their allies to use a skill before the user's next turn takes 20 damage.
For 2 turns, the floes grind in on every enemy: at the end of each of the user's turns, each enemy takes 5 damage for each of their skills on cooldown (max 15).
The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns, and Meltwater for as long as any of it remains.
Target enemy is Taunted by the user until they next take direct damage, for up to 4 turns.
For 3 turns, the user is Icebound, then Immune, and gains 1 Armor per skill of theirs on cooldown (max 3), rechecked as each hit lands.

kits.name: Aurora
kits.tagline: Ice and lightning lit up across the sky: the kit that bends energy colors.
kits.taglineHtml: Ice and lightning lit up across the sky: the kit that bends energy colors.
kits.playsLike: The energy-color kit: free yourself, scramble them
kits.notesHtml: Lightning changes how much energy a player has; Aurora changes which colors they have.

keywords.text: The bearer may pay colored costs with any color, as if they were random.
At the start of each of the bearer's turns, one of their player's energies changes to a random other color.

rows.effect: Deals 15 damage to target enemy, +5 per Charge the user has. Then 1 of that Charge is spent to give the user Shimmer until the end of their next turn.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Until the end of the user's next turn, Frost debuffs on everyone it hits last and can't be removed.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. The user has Shimmer for their next skill, which deals 10 more if it hits this enemy too.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Its user is Sapped twice, and their Sapped can't be removed for 3 turns. Invisible.
For 3 turns, each enemy the user damages directly is Dazzled for 2 turns, and the user deals 10 more direct damage to Dazzled enemies.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, 20 if they were already Dazzled, and Dazzles them for 2 turns.
Target enemy is Chilled until it lands on the following turn, and Sapped once for each energy their skills cost meanwhile. Then 35 Piercing damage. Channeled.
For 3 turns, the first time target enemy uses a skill, the lights go off around their whole team: they and each of their allies are Dazzled for 2 turns. Invisible.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Their Sapped turns into as much Charge; if they're Chilled, it ends and they gain Shimmer for 2 turns.
Summons an Aurora Fox (30 HP, Stormborn) permanently. Foxfire (r): 10 damage to target enemy, +5 per Charge the Fox has, and Dazzled for 1 turn.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If the user has Shimmer, it ends and this deals 15 more; if not, the user gains Shimmer for their next skill.
Deals 25 damage to all enemies. Chilled ones are Dazzled for 2 turns; the rest are Chilled for 1 turn.
Deals 5 damage to target enemy. Their player loses 1 energy of the color they hold most, and the user's player gains it.
Summons a Stray Aurora (30 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 15 damage to a random unit on whichever side has more total HP.
For up to 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, deals 5 damage to all enemies, and every ally has Shimmer. It ends early if the user takes direct damage. Channeled.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if their player has 1 or no energy left. Either way, they're Dazzled for 1 turn.
Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. All the user's Charge pours into them: they're Sapped once for each Charge spent.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and its light drifts to the user's side: their player gains 1 random energy for each energy it cost (up to 2). Invisible.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. For 3 turns, the lights strobe: the next skill they use leaves them Stunned for 1 turn afterward.
For 3 turns, the user gains Shimmer, and each skill they use gives them 1 Charge; every second one also gives 1 Swiftness.
Target ally heals 15. At the start of the user's next turn, they heal 5 more for each Frost debuff on the enemy team (max 30).
Target ally gains Shimmer for 2 turns, and all of the user's Charge moves to them.
Target enemy is Dazzled for 2 turns. Each time it changes one of their player's energies, they're also Sapped.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and Dazzles them for 1 turn. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them extends it by 1 turn.
All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield for 1 turn. Every skill on cooldown on the user's side comes 1 turn closer to ready.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. It arcs for 10 to a random other enemy, Dazzling them for 1 turn.
All enemies are Chilled for 2 turns. Meanwhile, the static leaps between them: each skill one of them uses gives a random ally of theirs 1 Confusion for 2 turns.
The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns, and has Shimmer while any of it remains.
Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each time an enemy the user Taunted damages them, the beacon flares: a random enemy who isn't Taunted is Taunted by the user for 1 turn.
For 3 turns, the user gains Shimmer and Immune, and 1 Armor for each color among their player's energies.

kits.name: Winter
kits.tagline: Ice on the wind: the season that pins everything in place.
kits.taglineHtml: Ice on the wind: the season that pins everything in place.
kits.playsLike: Pins targets down, then uses Wind's tools against the Immobile

keywords.text: Counts as a Frost debuff, and the bearer counts as Immobile. They lose their mobility buffs (Swiftness, Rushing, Leaping), can't gain new ones, and their mobility skills cost 1 more.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If they're moving (they have Swiftness, Rushing or Leaping), they're Snowbound for 2 turns.
The user Leaps. At the start of their next turn, if they're still Leaping, they land: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies.

The user gains 2 Swiftness for 2 turns. Their next Harmful skill ends the skate in a spray of ice: it spends their Swiftness for 5 more damage per stack, and every enemy it damages is Snowbound for 1 turn.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Every Frost debuff on its user shatters: it ends, and they take 15 Piercing damage for each. Invisible.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and any enemy who uses a mobility skill is Snowbound for 2 turns.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, +5 for each turn in a row the user has used Snowball. From the third in a row, they're also Snowbound for 1 turn.
On the following turn, the whiteout closes in: 60 Piercing damage, split evenly among the enemy characters who aren't Immobile then (or among all of them, if every one is). Channeled.
For 3 turns, if target enemy uses a mobility skill, it's countered, and they take 15 Piercing damage and are Snowbound for 2 turns. Invisible.
For 2 turns, the user is ready to spring: the first time an enemy uses a Harmful skill on them, they Leap before it lands, and that enemy is Snowbound for 1 turn.
Summons a Great Yeti (80 HP) permanently. Yeti Maul (nc): 30 damage to target enemy. At the start of each of the user's turns, their player pays 1 random energy to feed it, or it leaves.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. The gust carries on to a random other enemy: 10 damage, and they're Snowbound for 1 turn.
Deals 20 damage to all enemies. If the user is Rushing or Leaping, they stop, and every enemy is Snowbound for 1 turn, or 2 if they were both.
Deals 5 damage to target enemy and passes them the user's chill: every Frost debuff on the user (Snowbound included) moves to them. The user heals 10, plus 10 for each one passed.
Summons a Snow Sprite (20 HP) for 3 turns. Flurry (nc): 5 Piercing damage to all enemies. When the Sprite melts (it's destroyed or its time runs out), every enemy is Snowbound for 1 turn.
For up to 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, the cold deepens: 5 damage to all enemies, then 10, then 15. The third wave also leaves every enemy Snowbound for 2 turns. Channeled.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're Immobile. If the user is Rushing, the target is also Snowbound for 1 turn.
Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. The user is Frostbitten for 1 turn and gains Frostborn for 2.

For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, the gale snatches it: it's countered, and held frozen in the wind until the end of the user's next turn. The next Harmful skill the user uses meanwhile unleashes it too, as the user's own, on that skill's first target. Invisible.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, who is Snowbound for 2 turns. If they're still Snowbound at the end of their next turn, the squall freezes them solid: they're Stunned for 1 turn.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness, and begins Rushing. Whenever their Swiftness stops a Stun, the Stun's user is Snowbound for 2 turns.
Target ally heals 20. For 2 turns, whenever they damage an enemy with a Frost debuff, they begin Rushing.
Target ally gains Frostborn for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each enemy who damages them is Chilled for 1 turn.
Target enemy is Snowbound for 1 turn. Each skill they use while it lasts packs the snow tighter: it lasts 1 turn longer (up to 3 times).

Deals 20 damage to target enemy and coats them in frost for 1 turn: the second time the user's side damages them again meanwhile, the frost sets: 10 Piercing damage, and they're Frostbitten for 1 turn.
All allies heal 30 and gain 15 Shield for 1 turn. Then every unit on both sides, the user included, is Snowbound for 1 turn.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy. The descent rolls on through the others: each Immobile one takes 10, and each one still moving takes 5 and is Snowbound for 1 turn.
Enemies with a mobility skill or buff are Snowbound for 2 turns; Immobile enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns instead.
The user gains 10 Shield for 3 turns, and 10 more at the start of each of their turns meanwhile. It all melts the moment they use a damaging skill.
Target enemy is Snowbound for 1 turn, and Taunted by the user for as long as they stay Snowbound (up to 3 turns).
For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and no unit in the battle can be healed, the user included.

kits.name: Stasis
kits.tagline: Cold that stops the clock on poison: freeze the afflictions in place, then let them all go at once.
kits.taglineHtml: Cold that stops the clock on poison: freeze the afflictions in place, then let them all go at once.
kits.playsLike: Freeze the poison, then release it all

keywords.text: The bearer's effects don't tick, lose duration or deal damage while it lasts. When it ends, they Thaw: their Toxin deals its damage at once, doubled.
When Suspended ends, the bearer's Toxin deals its damage at once, doubled (10 Affliction per stack), then keeps ticking.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, their Toxin also deals its damage each time they use a skill.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy, who is Suspended for 1 turn. When they Thaw, each of their allies takes half the Thaw's damage.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, who gains 1 Toxin. The user's next Harmful skill makes its targets' Toxin deal its damage at once, doubled.
For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 2 Toxin and is Suspended for 1 turn, so the Toxin lands later as a Thaw. Invisible.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and their skills don't go on cooldown. When it ends, every skill of theirs goes 2 turns onto cooldown.
Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, who is Chilled for 1 turn. Then each Frost debuff on them lasts 1 turn longer.
Target enemy is Suspended until it lands on the following turn: 30 Piercing damage, and then they Thaw. Channeled.
For 3 turns, the first time target enemy is healed, they gain 2 Toxin and are Suspended for 1 turn, stalling their Renew. Invisible.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and is Suspended for 2: their Buffs hold, and their Debuffs wait. Unstunnable.
Summons an Ice Spider (30 HP) permanently. Frost Web (r): target enemy is Suspended for 1 turn. Frozen Fang (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin; a Suspended target Thaws at once instead.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each time their Toxin ticks, they're Chilled for 1 more turn.
Deals 25 damage to all enemies. Then every unit on both sides, the user included, is Suspended for 1 turn.
Target enemy gains 1 Toxin. Then their Toxin deals its damage at once, doubled, and the user heals as much as it deals.
Summons a Cryo Sprite (20 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, it gives the enemy with the least HP 1 Toxin, or Suspends them for 1 turn instead if they're Prey.
For up to 4 turns, every enemy is Suspended, and at the end of each of the user's turns a random enemy gains 1 Toxin. When it ends, they all Thaw. Channeled.
Deals 5 Piercing damage to target enemy, who gains 1 Toxin. The cold builds while it's held: 5 more for each turn the user went without using Icebite (max 15 more).
Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, who is Suspended for 1 turn. When they Thaw, the wound reopens: 20 Piercing damage again.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the cold sets in: every Debuff on them, Stuns aside, lasts 2 turns longer. Invisible.
Target enemy gains 2 Toxin and is Suspended for 1 turn. When they Thaw, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

For 3 turns, the user is Suspended, so their Buffs hold. At the end of each of their turns meanwhile, they gain 1 Might and 1 Swiftness; these pile up while the Suspension holds them, then last 1 turn more.
Target ally heals 25 and loses their Toxin, then is Suspended for 1 turn.
Target ally gains 2 Might for 2 turns, then is Suspended for 2 turns so their Buffs hold.
Target enemy is Confused and Suspended for 2 turns. Each skill they use meanwhile adds 1 Toxin to them, held for the Thaw.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, who is Suspended for 1 turn. The ice keeps every hit the user's side lands on them meanwhile: when they Thaw, half of it all lands again as Affliction (max 30).
All allies heal 15 and lose their Toxin, gaining 10 Shield for 1 turn for each stack lost.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy, who gains as much Toxin as the target has (max 3) and is Suspended for 1 turn.
All enemies are Chilled for 4 turns and Suspended for 1, so the Chill holds. Any who were already Chilled gain 1 Toxin first.
The user gains 10 Shield for 1 turn. At the start of their next turn, they heal all the HP they lost since using this, up to 40.
For 2 turns, target enemy is Taunted by the user, and each time they damage the user, they gain 1 Toxin. Then their Toxin deals its damage at once, doubled.
For 3 turns, the user gains Immune, and damage they take is held instead of landing. Each held hit lands 3 turns later, halved, as Affliction.

kits.name: Myth
kits.tagline: Ice and stone that remember: the old legends of the frozen north, and the hero who becomes one.
kits.taglineHtml: Ice and stone that remember: the old legends of the frozen north, and the hero who becomes one.
kits.playsLike: A hero who becomes a giant of legend

keywords.text: At 3 Legend, the bearer becomes Mythic for 3 turns; Legend resets when Mythic ends.
+20 max HP (and 20 healing), 2 Armor, can't be Stunned, and Myth skills gain their Mythic riders.

passives.name: Saga
passives.text: Gains 1 Legend each time this character uses a Myth skill (except Awakened Giant) or kills an enemy or minion; at 3, they become Mythic.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, or 30 if the user has no allied minions. Mythic: it also hits a random other enemy for 15.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, +5 to each hit per allied Boulder. Mythic: the user creates a Boulder for each enemy it hits.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Boulder, it's destroyed to add half its HP to the hit; if not, they create one. Mythic: the Boulder isn't destroyed.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and creates a Boulder when it does. Mythic: it reflects the skill instead of countering it. Invisible.
The user gains 2 Legend and creates a Boulder, then becomes Immune for 2 turns.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, plus 5 per Legend the user has. Can instead target an allied Boulder to shatter it into legend: the user gains 1 Legend per 15 HP it had (at most 3).
20 Piercing damage to target enemy, growing by 20 at the end of each of the user's turns. It lands at 60, or as soon as the user takes damage. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
For 3 turns, whenever any enemy uses the same skill they used on their previous turn, they take 20 damage. Invisible.
The user is Stunned and Invulnerable until the end of their next turn, and gains 1 more Legend.
Summons a Mammoth (55 HP) permanently; while it stands, Frost debuffs on enemies can't be removed. Trample (r): 15 damage to all enemies.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy; the user gains 1 more Legend if they have a Frost debuff. Mythic: their Frost debuffs also spread to a random ally of theirs.
Deals 25 damage to all enemies. Enemy minions it kills become allied Boulders. Mythic: every enemy minion it hits becomes one, dead or not.
Deals 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it and 5 more for each round the battle has lasted (max 40).
Summons 2 Trolls (20 HP) for 3 turns. Club (r): 10 damage to target enemy. When a Troll dies or expires, it turns to stone: an allied Boulder with 20 HP.
For 3 turns, the user creates a Boulder at the end of each of their turns. When it ends, every allied Boulder awakens as a Rime Giant (Frost Maul (nc): 15 damage). Channeled.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, +5 per Frost debuff on them (max 25 in all).
Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +20 if they have more HP than the user. If it kills, the user gains 1 more Legend. Mythic: the bonus always applies.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and for 3 turns their cooldowns don't tick down while they have a Frost debuff. Invisible.
Target enemy is Stunned and gains 25 Shield for 3 turns; the Stun ends if the Shield breaks. Mythic: it doesn't.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and 1 more of each for every earlier use of this skill in the battle.
Target ally heals 20, and the user creates a Boulder with 10 HP for each Frost debuff on the enemy team (max 40).
Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random for 2 turns; an allied minion gains both. Mythic: a non-minion ally also becomes Mythic until the end of their next turn.
Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. If they die before it ends, the doom falls on their kin: every ally of theirs is Confused for 2 turns.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them gives the user 1 Legend. Mythic: those allies also gain 1 Armor.
All allies heal 20, and allied minions heal to full. Mythic: allies also gain 20 max HP while the user stays Mythic.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy. The sweep widens with the saga: 1 random other enemy per Legend the user has takes 10. Mythic: every other enemy takes 10 and is Frostbitten for 1 turn.
For each enemy, a random skill of theirs that's cooling down is set back 2 turns (3 while the user is Mythic). An enemy with nothing cooling down is Intimidated for 2 turns instead.

The user raises a rampart: they create a Boulder (25 HP), and until their next turn, while they have an allied minion, each direct hit on them is split: they take half, and a random allied minion takes the other half.
Target enemy is Taunted until the user next becomes Mythic (at most 4 turns); if that ends it, the feud is settled and they take 25 damage. If the user is already Mythic, the Taunt lasts 2 turns.
The user becomes Mythic now, for 3 turns +1 per Legend they had, and is Immune for as long.

kits.name: Prism
kits.tagline: Light through ice: split it to reach everyone, or focus it to burn through one.
kits.taglineHtml: Light through ice: split it to reach everyone, or focus it to burn through one.
kits.playsLike: Split light to spread it, focus it to burst

keywords.text: The bearer's next skill doesn't Refract, and its direct damage is 50% stronger. Using a skill spends the Lens.
A Refracting skill also affects one more random unit on its target's side at half strength (half damage, healing or stacks, rounded down to 5 or 1; durations unchanged).

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Refract; if the refracted hit lands on a Frostbitten enemy, it's full strength.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. At the start of the user's next turn, the light falls again: 10 more to each of them who still has a Frost debuff.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. The user's next skill costs nothing, but its cooldown is 2 turns longer.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, which Refracts instead: a random ally of its user takes 15 damage. Invisible.
For 3 turns, the user is Immune. They gain Lens, and the glass heats with every Lens: each time they use a skill with Lens meanwhile, they gain 1 Might until this ends.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If they use a Helpful skill on their next turn, they're Numb for 2 turns afterward.
On the following turn, deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy, and the beam splits into a spectrum: 15 Piercing damage to each other enemy. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
For 3 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they're Frostbitten for 2 turns, and it Refracts: a random ally of theirs is Frostbitten for 2 turns too. Invisible.

First, 1 of target enemy's Armor rots into 1 Vulnerable; then deals them 10 Piercing damage, or 15 if they already had Spores, and they gain 1 Spore.

Summons a Ghoul Gravedigger (40 HP) permanently. Gnaw (nc): 10 damage, and it heals 10. Unearth (r): spends 2 of the user's Graves to Raise a Skeleton; with fewer, it digs 1 Grave.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy, +10 for each Soul Fragment the user spends, up to 3. If it kills them, the spent fragments return to the user, with 1 more.
Raise: the user spends up to 2 Graves for as many Skeletons, each bursting out under a random enemy for 15 damage. Then deals 20 damage to all enemies.

If there's no allied minion, a Skeleton claws up for the user first, spending no Grave. Then drains 10 HP from every minion on both sides; the user heals the total. Minions that die leave Graves as usual.
Raise: the user spends up to 2 Graves for as many Skeletons. With no Graves, the user digs 1 instead.
For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, deals 10 damage to all enemies. Any unit or minion that dies meanwhile rises for the user as a Skeleton. Channeled.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If that leaves them at 15 HP or less, the user spends 2 Graves, if they have them, to kill them.
Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. While the user is Immortal, it also costs them 20 HP and deals 20 more.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and buried: its cooldown rises by 3. Invisible.
Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, plus 1 more turn for each Grave the user spends, up to 2.
The user gains 5 Shield per Grave, up to 25, until the end of their next turn. If they already had Shield from this skill, they dig 1 Grave first.
Spends 1 Grave: target ally heals 30. With no Grave to spend, they heal 10.

Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Helpful skill they use while Horrified sprouts a Seedling for the user.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each time they're healed, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them.
All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield, and heal 10 more for each unit or minion that died since the user's last turn.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Then every minion on the field, on both sides, takes 15 damage.
All units on both sides except the user are Intimidated for 2 turns.
The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. When it breaks, a Skeleton rises from the bones for the user, spending no Grave.
Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. If the user dies meanwhile, they rise as a Ghoul, spending no Grave, and the Taunt carries on to it.

kits.name: Moon
kits.tagline: Stone that shines in the dark: a four-beat rhythm of hiding, growing, striking and draining.
kits.taglineHtml: Stone that shines in the dark: a four-beat rhythm of hiding, growing, striking and draining.
kits.playsLike: A four-beat rhythm: hide, grow, strike, drain
kits.notesHtml: The cycle is predictable, so both players can plan around the Full Moon.

keywords.text: Starts at New Moon and advances at the end of each of this character's turns: New, Waxing, Full, Waning. Moon skills add the current phase's rider.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. New Moon: Stealthy. Waning: the user heals half the damage dealt.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, 5 more to each for every phase since the New Moon (Waning: 30 and 25). Then the user's Lunar Cycle falls back to New Moon.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, and the user gains Stealth. Their Lunar Cycle holds this turn instead of advancing. Stealthy.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. New Moon: it counters every Harmful skill used on them instead. Invisible.

The beast takes the user: their Lunar Cycle leaps to the Full Moon and holds there for 3 turns. For as long, their direct hits deal 10 more damage and heal them for half the damage dealt, but their Strategic skills are Stunned.
Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. Waxing: the shard stays lodged, dealing 15 more at the start of the next Full Moon.
The user stalks target enemy. On the following turn, they deal 30 damage to them, 10 more for each hit the user's allies land on them before then (max 60). Channeled.
For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they fall Asleep and are Isolated for 1 turn. Invisible.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and the Lunar Cycle advances one extra phase at the end of the turn. Stealthy.
Summons a Lunar Wolf (35 HP) permanently. Moonfang (r): 10 Piercing damage. At the start of each Full Moon, it howls: it heals 20, and a random enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, who is Blinded for longer the darker the moon: 4 turns at the New Moon, 3 Waxing, 2 Full, 1 Waning.
Deals 25 damage to all enemies. Full Moon: Blinded ones fall Asleep after the hit. Waning: the user heals 5 per enemy hit.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user for the damage dealt. Waning: it drains every enemy instead.
Summons 2 Moon Moths (10 HP) for 3 turns, and every Blinded enemy is Taunted by one for 1 turn. Flutter (r): 10 damage to target enemy.
Until the next New Moon, deals 10 damage to all enemies at the end of each of the user's turns. If it lasts to the New Moon, every enemy falls Asleep. Channeled.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Their Blind ends, and they're Isolated for 2 turns instead.
Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy, then the frenzy takes the user: they're Blinded through their next turn.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the false light Blinds every enemy for 1 turn. Invisible.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, then they and a random ally of theirs share one dream: both fall Asleep for 1 turn, and damage that wakes either one wakes both.
For 2 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and the phase's gift: New, Stealth; Waxing, 2 Armor; Full, 2 Might; Waning, 2 Renew.
Target ally heals 40. 3 turns later, the moonlight wanes and they lose 20 HP, which can't kill them.
Target ally sinks into a moonlit dream through their next turn: they're Asleep and Invulnerable. When they wake, they gain 2 Might for 2 turns and 3 Renew.
For 3 turns, target enemy's skills are Stunned in alternation: non-Strategic ones on their first and third turns, Strategic ones on their second.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, every unit on both sides is Sanctified.
All allies heal 20. New Moon: they gain Stealth. Waxing: 2 Renew. Full: 1 Might for 2 turns. Waning: every enemy gains 1 Weakness.
Deals 10 damage to target enemy, and the crescent shatters: a Moonshard lodges in each other enemy, dealing 15 damage at the start of the next Full Moon.
The user howls as the Lunar Wolves do at the Full Moon: they heal 20, and every enemy is Taunted by them for 1 turn.
The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Whatever is left of it when it ends becomes a Boulder for the user, with that much HP.
Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time an ally of the user damages them, the Taunt passes to that ally.
For 3 turns, the moon's face glares from the user: each enemy who hits them is Blinded for 2 turns, and deals them 10 less damage while Blinded.

kits.name: Zealot
kits.tagline: Holy and unholy in one soul: faith that feeds on suffering, and a death that serves the cause.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy and unholy in one soul: faith that feeds on suffering, and a death that serves the cause.
kits.playsLike: Suffering fuels faith; even death helps

keywords.text: +5 damage per stack to the bearer's Zealot skills (max 5). +1 whenever an enemy damages the bearer or gives them a Debuff. Martyr: when the bearer dies, each of their allies heals 10 per stack and gains 1 Might per 2.
When a unit with Fervor dies, each of their allies heals 10 per stack and gains 1 Might per 2 stacks.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, +5 for each Debuff on the user. The user gains 1 Fervor.

Deals 15 damage to target enemy. The user's next skill costs 1 less for every 25 HP they're missing.
For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, who gains 2 Fervor as if it had landed. Invisible.
For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might. Debuffs enemies would give them are prevented and give them 1 Fervor each instead.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. The user spends 1 Fervor, if they have one, to heal 15.

Deals 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Then the user takes every Debuff their allies have onto themselves, for the turns each had left.
Summons an Initiate (20 HP, 1 Fervor) for 3 turns. Take the Blow (nc): the next Harmful skill aimed at target ally hits the Initiate instead.
For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, they take 10 Affliction and gain 1 Fervor, then a random enemy takes 5 damage per Fervor stack they have. Channeled.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy, and the user's penance goes into the wound: a random Debuff of theirs moves onto that enemy, with the time it had left.
Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each Horrified enemy loses a random Buff at the start of their turn.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and each of its targets heals 10 per Fervor the user has. Invisible.
All enemies are Stunned for 1 turn. The user takes 15 Affliction damage for each one Stunned.
The user spends 1 Fervor for 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus until the end of their next turn. With none, they gain 1 Fervor and 1 Confusion for 1 turn.
The user takes 15 damage and gains 1 Fervor; target ally heals 20.

Target enemy is Sanctified for 2 turns. Meanwhile, whenever their Sanctify triggers, every other ally of the damager heals 5 too.
Deals 30 damage to target enemy. The user is Sanctified for 1 turn.
All allies heal 25. Any ally who dies before the user's next turn is a Martyr as if they had 3 Fervor.
Deals 25 damage to target enemy, and 15 to each other enemy with a Debuff, if the target has one too.
For 2 turns, each Buff an enemy would gain is lost, and the user gains 1 Fervor for it.
For 1 turn, each enemy hit on the user hardens them: after it lands, they gain 15 Shield for 1 turn.
Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. If the user is killed meanwhile, their killer takes 10 Affliction damage per Fervor stack the user had.
For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune. When it ends, they're a Martyr without dying: their allies get the Martyr payout for the user's Fervor, which is then spent.

kits.name: Vigilante
kits.tagline: Holy light from the shadows: justice outside the law, dragging hidden things into the open.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy light from the shadows: justice outside the law, dragging hidden things into the open.
kits.playsLike: Works from the shadows to drag the enemy's into the light

keywords.text: Can't become Stealthed, Invulnerable or Untargetable (any they have ends), and the Invisible effects they own are revealed. Vigilante skills deal them 10 more.

Summons an Informant (15 HP) for 3 turns. Whoever damages it is Exposed for 2 turns. Tip Off (r): the user's next skill is Stealthy.
For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, every enemy who used a Harmful skill since takes 10 damage and is Exposed for 1 turn. Channeled.

Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Exposed, it ends, and they're Stunned for 1 turn.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Condemned; for 2 turns, any ally of theirs who gives them a Buff is Exposed for 2 turns. Invisible.

The last enemy to damage target ally takes 10 damage, and the ally heals 10 plus the damage dealt. If no enemy has damaged them, they heal 15 instead.
For 3 turns, the first time target ally takes damage, they gain 25 Shield and 2 Might for 2 turns. Invisible.

Deals 15 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, they owe restitution: after each Harmful skill they use, each of its targets heals 10.
All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Each Anointed ally spends their Anointed to remove all their Debuffs.

kits.name: Curse
kits.tagline: Unholy in the shadows: hexes that punish every kind of choice, and outlive their victims.
kits.taglineHtml: Unholy in the shadows: hexes that punish every kind of choice, and outlive their victims.
kits.playsLike: Curses that punish choices and refuse to leave

keywords.text: Whenever the bearer deals direct damage, they take 10 Affliction. Lingers.
The bearer's Strategic skills cost 1 more random energy. Lingers.
Whenever the bearer gains a Buff, they take 10 Affliction. Lingers.

Debuffs that each punish one kind of action: Pain (dealing damage), Silence (Strategic skills) and Ruin (gaining Buffs). Lingering: when a Hexed unit dies or has a Hex cleansed, that Hex jumps to a random ally of theirs with its remaining duration; Hexes that simply run out are gone.

rows.effect: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, who gains a random Hex for 2 turns.

Deals 15 damage to target enemy, and the user's next Harmful skill gives each enemy it targets a random Hex for 2 turns.

For 2 turns, if the Snare on target enemy is cleansed, they're Stunned for 1 turn and gain Hex of Ruin for 3 turns. Invisible.

Deals 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Each Hex on them is shortened by 1 turn, and the user heals 10 more per Hex shortened.
Summons a Hex Shade (15 HP) for 3 turns. Whisper (r): target enemy gains a random Hex for 2 turns.
For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy gains a random Hex for 2 turns; if they already had it, they take 20 Affliction instead. Channeled.
Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If the user is Hexed, one of their Hexes, chosen at random, passes into the wound: it moves onto the target, and the hit deals 25 instead.
Target enemy loses a random Buff, or gains Hex of Ruin for 2 turns if they have none. Then deals 30 Piercing damage to them.
For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and their Hexes last 1 turn longer. The user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn. Invisible.
Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn. When it ends, the Stun passes to a random enemy who hasn't had it, until every enemy has been Stunned once.
The user gains 1 Swiftness. For 3 turns, whenever an enemy gains a Buff, the user gains a copy, and the enemy's lasts 1 turn less.
Target ally heals 20, and their Hexes and other Debuffs move to a random enemy.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 2 Might and Lifesteal, but they're Isolated for as long.
Target enemy gains all three Hexes for 2 turns.
Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Blinds them for 1 turn. For 2 turns, each skill they use while Blinded lets the user drain a Soul Fragment from them.

Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Then the grudge falls on whichever other enemy has the most HP: they take Affliction damage equal to half the HP they have over the target (at least 5, at most 25).
All enemies gain Hex of Silence for 2 turns. The first Strategic skill each of them uses meanwhile leaves them Intimidated for 2 turns.
The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. Each enemy who damages it is Blinded for 1 turn. Stealthy.
